Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] U.S. Senator [[Mitch McConnell]] won re-election to a third term with a 12.6% margin of victory over Democrat Steve Beshear, who later successfully ran in [[2007 Kentucky gubernatorial election|2007]] and [[2011 Kentucky gubernatorial election|2011]] for governor of Kentucky. ==Republican primary== ===Candidates=== * Tommy Klein, |title=Candidate financial totals |url=https://www.fec.gov/data/elections/senate/KY/1996/ |website=[[Federal Election Commission]]}} |} ===Campaign=== In 1996, Beshear started out trailing against McConnell, with an early general election poll placing McConnell ahead of Beshear 50% to 32%.{{cite news | author=Janofsky, Michael | title = Political Briefing;The Campaigns for Congress | newspaper=[[The New York Times]] | date=June 25, 1996}} The campaign ultimately became quite harsh, with the McConnell campaign sending "Hunt Man," a take off of [[Chicken George (politics)|Chicken George]] dressed in "the red velvet coat, jodhpurs, black riding boots and black helmet of a patrician [[fox hunting|fox hunter]]." This was done as a means of criticizing Beshear's membership in a fox hunting club in [[Lexington, KY|Lexington]], and undercut the Beshear campaign's message that McConnell was a Republican in the mold of [[Newt Gingrich]] and that Beshear was the only friend of the working class in the race.{{cite news | author=Wines, Michael | title = The Campaigns For Congress | newspaper=[[The New York Times]] | date=August 11, 1996 | url=https://www.nytimes.com/1996/08/11/us/the-campaigns-for-congress.html?scp=10&sq=%22steve%20beshear%22&st=cse}} Beshear did not make much traction with the electorate during the campaign. By October 1996, Beshear had narrowed the gap between himself and McConnell slightly, with McConnell leading Beshear 50% to 38%.{{cite news | title = McConnell Holds 12-Point Lead Over Beshear in Poll | date=October 6, 1996 | newspaper=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]] | url=http://nl.newsbank.com/nl-search/we/Archives?p_product=LH&s_site=kentucky&p_multi=LH&p_theme=realcities&p_action=search&p_maxdocs=200&p_topdoc=1&p_text_direct-0=0EB740A68192605C&p_field_direct-0=document_id&p_perpage=10&p_sort=YMD_date:D&s_trackval=GooglePM}} ===Results=== {{Election box begin | title = General election results{{Cite web|url=https://clerk.house.gov/member_info/electionInfo/1996/96Stat.htm#12|title=Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives}}}} {{Election box winning candidate with party link | party = Republican Party (United States) | candidate = [[Mitch McConnell]] (incumbent) | votes = 724,794 | percentage = 55.45% | change = +3.27% }} {{Election box candidate with party link | party = Democratic Party (United States) | candidate = [[Steve Beshear]] | votes = 560,012 | percentage = 42.85% | change = -4.97% }} {{Election box candidate with party link | party = Libertarian Party (United States) | candidate = Dennis L.
